design.decision: Hold a high trump or the last card of a long suit for the final trick.
design.opponent: Revealed on the last trick; opponents can save a trump to contest it.
design.rationale: The contract-points counterpart of seed-last-trick, lost on a set, so it rewards the endgame plan only when the contract holds.
design.draftText: +50 contract points when your team wins the last trick of a round

critic.concerns: Same signature as cb-last-trick-points, differing only in amount; merge them.

history.note: draft-common: merged into cb-last-trick-points (same signature; the amount sweep decides the number), per the critic.
